link.title: Kubernetes | Rootless Nodes and User Namespaces in Kubernetes 1.37

entry.summary:
Kubernetes 1.37 promoted KubeletInUserNamespace, also called rootless mode, to beta. It lets node components run inside a Linux user namespace as a non-root user on the host. This is useful defense in depth for teams exploring stronger isolation on shared machines, local clusters, and other supported environments.
